mods.name: sounds-zen
mods.description: Soft bells and singing-bowl tones: a bell when tests pass, a low bowl when they fail, a muted chime when a call is blocked, a bowl when a turn ends.

mods.name: sounds-arcade
mods.description: Arcade blips: a coin when tests pass, a game-over drop when they fail, a buzz when a call is blocked, a power-up when a turn ends.
